stories.title: AI robot tech bros dogs run wild in Berlin gallery
stories.summary: In Germany, robotic AI dogs with the faces of tech's most powerful men are on the loose — courtesy of American artist Beeple.

stories.title: Iran war shakes Global economy as energy costs surge and recession fears grow
stories.summary: From energy markets to everyday prices, the fallout from the Iran war is reshaping the global economy.

stories.title: For one civil rights activist, Supreme Court ruling is 'bewildering'
stories.summary: Civil rights activist Leslie McLemore reflects on the recent Supreme Court decision on the Voting Rights Act, and what the ruling means for Black political representation in the South.

stories.title: In 'The Devil Wears Prada 2,' Runway Magazine is in peril
stories.summary: After two decades, Runway magazine's fashionistas — Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel — are back, and the stakes are higher in The Devil Wears Prada 2.

stories.title: Olivia Pichardo took the pitcher's mound for the Bears and made history
stories.summary: Olivia Pichardo at Brown University is striking out D1 baseball players as the first woman in the game.

stories.title: After Canada loosens citizenship requirements, thousands of people apply
stories.summary: After Canada changed a law opening up citizenship opportunities, thousands of Americans are trying to become citizens of their northern neighbor. It's partly for political and personal reasons.
